summary: The comment argues against tying E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes, emphasizing the importance of access to technology and education for economic and societal progress.

claims.requested_action: Tie E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes
claims.argument: The comment argues that taking away access to technology will keep students disenfranchised and ignorant.
claims.evidence_quote: Taking away access to technology, the internet, and advances in STEM will keep access out of the hands of students who are already disenfranchised. If your goal is to have a nation of ignorant adults, kill access.
